CustomField.description: Admin-editable summary string rendered when the section is collapsed. Token grammar: `{QuestionDevName}` substitutes the question's value (blank segments + surrounding punctuation collapse); `{QuestionDevName ? "yes-text" : "no-text"}` for boolean questions; `{address:QuestionDevName}` for `lightning-input-address` compound questions (formats as `Street, Apt N, City, State Zip`).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Summary text shown when the section collapses. Use {QuestionDevName} tokens, {Q ? "yes" : "no"} ternaries, and {address:Q} for address compounds.
CustomField.label: Summary Template
